scene: Inside the warm caramel refinery, sweet machinery hums.
picture: Flat side view. Inside the warm refinery, the South Asian girl in her teal hoodie sits in her purple wheelchair on the left. On the far left, a brass valve wheel gleams on pipes. Centre, a bubbling copper caramel vat churns. On the far right stands an open glass sugar elevator.
shown: A large brass valve wheel attached to a dripping pipe on the far left
A wide copper vat filled with bubbling gold caramel standing in the centre
An open glass sugar elevator with glowing buttons waiting at the far right

variants.scene: Steam rises around you as rich caramel churns in giant copper pots.
Golden syrup drips from pipes while you search everywhere for {quest}.
Clockwork gears click as the air fills with sweet, buttery steam.
